title: Upload page shows sizes, totals, and per-image status
summary: The comic upload form now lists every selected image with size, dimensions, and status, plus live totals against the server limits.
body:
Before sending, uploaders had no idea how big their selection was — oversized batches died with a cryptic error after a long wait.

The form now shows a live panel: file count, total size, each image's dimensions, and a per-file status (ok, will be optimized, not an image). Individual files can be removed from the batch, and the submit button disables itself with the reason while anything is over a limit.
